title: Per-ticker alternative data (market_data/weekly/{date}/alternative/{ticker}.json, D15)
description: Producer: collectors/alternative.py::_fetch_all_alternative / _process_one_ticker (data-collector plan P-07, alpha-engine-config-I10870, D15). Consumer: SELF-CONSUMED — nousergon-data features/compute.py::_load_cached_alternative -> _alt_entry_from_payload, the only reader of this key (no cross-repo boundary). Schema pins the fields _alt_entry_from_payload actually projects onto the feature store: eps_revision.{surprise_pct,days_since_earnings,revision_4w,streak}, analyst_consensus.earnings_surprises[].surprise_pct (fallback when eps_revision.surprise_pct is absent), options_flow.{put_call_ratio,iv_rank,expected_move_pct}.

surprise_pct.description: percent-point number (e.g. -0.8873 for -0.887%), NOT a decimal pct — _alt_entry_from_payload divides by 100 before it reaches the feature store's _pct convention
